dhpView.personalStory: Jordan, it's clear you're navigating a significant transition from university life to your career aspirations, and it's completely understandable to feel invisible after many applications. You've built a strong foundation with your Bachelor of Communications from UTS, where you developed key skills in writing, audience awareness, and campaign thinking. Your current hospitality role, while not directly in marketing, is actively building your customer communication, reliability, and teamwork skills – these are highly valued in any professional setting. You're looking for an entry-level content or marketing role where you can apply your writing, customer empathy, and project thinking, and your DHP is here to help you showcase that potential and connect with the right opportunities.

insightCards.title: Feeling Invisible? Your DHP Helps.
insightCards.body: It's tough when applications don't get responses. Your DHP helps by presenting a rich, evidence-based profile that goes beyond a resume, making your skills and potential visible to employers.

insightCards.title: Top Match: Junior Content Coordinator
insightCards.body: Great news, Jordan! The Junior Content Coordinator role at Civic Spark Studio is a strong fit for your current skills. With your writing sample and hospitality communication evidence, you're well-positioned to apply.

insightCards.title: Boost Your AI Fluency
insightCards.body: You're already using AI tools like ChatGPT and Canva. To confidently use AI for employer-facing work, focusing on prompt framing, output checking, and privacy judgment will be a valuable next step.
